title: PayStatements
description: Pay statements is a list of summary information on the pay statements of an associate and a reference to the detail.

retirementPlanIndicator.description: True indicates that the user has the retirement plan feature.  If payroll system knows that the user has retirement plan feature then the value is 'true'.  The value is 'false' If the payroll system does not know whether the user has retirement plans feature

excludeYTDAmountsIndicator.description: Indicates if all YTD amounts are excluded from the response.  'True' by default for Celergo, 'False' for all other payroll engines

signatureEnabledIndicator.description: Indicates if the pay statements could be digitally signed

signatureDisagreementEnabledIndicator.description: Indicates if signature option of 'signed with no agreement' is allowed

adjustmentIndicator.description: To indicate if a given statement represents an adjustment.  The regular statement is assumed if the indicator is omitted

commentIndicator.description: To indicate if a given statement has comments

netPayAmount.description: The Amount paid after all deductions are taken out

grossPayAmount.description: The Amount paid before any deductions are taken out

grossPayYTDAmount.description: The Year To Date Amount paid before any deductions are taken out.  This may not be shown on the pay statement or it may be zero or some value

totalHours.description: The total duration in hours for the related pay

payDetailUri.description: The URI to the detail of a paystatement.  The detail shows all deductions, earnings, direct deposit, etc.

statementImageUri.description: The URI to the image of the pay statement e.g. pdf. This should be the relative uri
